segments.text: A cron job runs every minute as bandit twenty-four, and executes every script dropped in a spool directory.
I log in as bandit23 with ssh bandit23@bandit.labs.overthewire.org -p 2220.
I read the cron definition for bandit twenty-four.
It runs the job every minute as bandit twenty-four, and also at reboot.
The note says the job runs every script dropped in var spool bandit twenty-four foo, as bandit twenty-four.
So I drop in a script that copies bandit twenty-four's password file to temp slash b23out.
Then I wait sixty seconds for the next run, and cat the output file.
The password for bandit twenty-four is there, and the level is solved.
